description.value: Red Baron Restaurant is a family-owned seaside eatery at Crescent Beach in Surrey serving fish and chips, ice cream, and frozen yogurt. Situated beside the beach, it offers a quiet atmosphere with outdoor seating, making it a natural pit stop for cyclists riding the coastal routes. The shop carries a wide variety of ice cream flavors and accepts U.S. currency.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://redbaronrestaurantsurrey.mybistro.online/ confirms the business name, address (12180 Beecher St, Surrey, BC V4A 3A6), and phone (604-541-8511 not in OSM but found on site). The business info section explicitly lists 'Bike Parking: Yes', 'Take-out: Yes', and 'Wi-Fi: No'. Recent reviews dated May 2026 confirm the business is currently operating.
